q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an LED panel light?
title: LED panel light carbon footprint
short: Weigh the aluminium frame, diffuser, light guide plate, LED strips, driver and packing, and multiply each by its supplier's figure. Add assembly, ageing and testing electricity per panel. The aluminium frame and driver are usually large shares.

ul: Aluminium frame or back cover by weight.
Diffuser and light guide plate in acrylic or polystyrene.
LED strips, driver with its PCB, and wiring.
SMT line for LED boards, if done in house.
Assembly and ageing racks, which draw power for hours.

p: Report per panel by size and wattage; buyers may also ask per lumen.

example.title: Worked example: panel assembly per unit (one month)
lines: Plant total: 10,650 / 30,000 = 0.355 kg CO2 per panel
Add aluminium, plastics, LEDs and driver for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
